title: Risk-optimal active learning with informative abstention
abstract: arXiv:2611.24986v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study label acquisition when an oracle may abstain and its response probability shares parameters with the classifier. A query can then provide information through both a returned label and the response outcome. Under a correctly specified parametric model, we derive the classifier information after adjustment for response-model nuisance parameters. Combining this information with the local curvature of multiclass zero-one risk gives an acquisition criterion for minimizing the leading asymptotic excess risk. We characterize the optimal allocation under a fixed query budget and show how query allocation affects response identifiability. The oracle criterion reduces to response-discounted acquisition when response probability does not depend on the classifier parameters. Simulations examine the resulting query allocations and isolate the contribution of the response-outcome term through an ablation. A Consumer Complaints replay retain

translated_title: 具有信息性弃权的风险最优主动学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在预言机可能弃权且其响应概率与分类器共享参数的情形下的标签获取问题。此时，一次查询可以通过返回的标签和响应结果两条途径提供信息。在正确设定的参数模型下，我们推导出对响应模型冗余参数进行调整后的分类器信息。将该信息与多类零一风险的局部曲率相结合，得到了一个用于最小化首阶渐近超额风险的查询获取准则。我们刻画了固定查询预算下的最优分配方案，并展示了查询分配如何影响响应模型的可识别性。当响应概率不依赖于分类器参数时，该预言机准则退化为响应折扣式获取。仿真实验考察了由此得到的查询分配，并通过消融实验分离出响应结果项的贡献。此外还基于消费者投诉数据回放进行了实验验证。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种在预言机可能弃权且响应概率与分类器共享参数情形下的主动学习查询获取准则，通过结合调整冗余参数后的分类器信息与多类零一风险的局部曲率，实现首阶渐近超额风险的最小化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a query acquisition criterion for active learning in which an oracle may abstain and its response probability shares parameters with the classifier, minimizing the leading asymptotic excess risk by combining nuisance-adjusted classifier information with the local curvature of the multiclass zero-one risk.
